recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work should use newer issues for translation handling, matching semantics, or resource-specific language use cases rather than changing the historical FHIR-3084 disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-3084 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core request, applied for DSTU1, to add a search parameter "language" for all resource types so clients could find resources in a particular language, especially Questionnaires. The Jira resolution records approval and comments that the change was already done.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-3084 was found. Early search page history shows the all-resource `_language` parameter documented in 2014 alongside `_id`, matching the Jira comment that the request had already been applied. The original DSTU1-era application was later removed by FHIR-7954 because its semantics were considered under-specified.
additional_context: FHIR-32020 later reintroduced `_language` for R5, with final resolution defining it as a token search against `Resource.language` and requiring search page table/list updates. The current source includes the Resource search-parameter definition and search page documentation. FHIR-32020 already has a combined-branch audit commit, so this reconciliation only publishes the seed audit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because `source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml` defines `Resource-_language` and `source/search.html` documents and lists `_language` among common all-resource search parameters.

related_jiras.note: Published 2015 issue removed the original all-resource `_language` parameter because the matching semantics were under-specified.
Published R5 issue reintroduced `_language` as a token search parameter against `Resource.language`; it is already represented on the combined branch.
